title: Verified experience improves materials prediction with large language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33195v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Materials discovery is an iterative loop: experiments and calculations verify predictions, and each outcome can inform the next. Yet most predictors are specialized single-task models fixed after training. Large language models have recently emerged as predictors across heterogeneous tasks but generally underperform specialized models, and retrieval-augmented variants discard their own outcomes. Benchmarks also score queries in isolation, leaving improvement from outcomes untested. Here we construct MatMemBench, a sequential benchmark of 22 materials tasks that reveals outcomes only after prediction and tests online adaptation, memory retention and cross-task transfer. We present MatRecall, a framework that lets large language models store verified predictions, with evidence, outcome and error, as episodes and recall them without retraining. translated_title: 经验证的经验可提升大语言模型的材料预测能力
translated_abstract: 材料发现是一个迭代循环：实验和计算验证预测结果，而每一次结果都可以为下一步提供信息。然而，大多数预测器是训练后即固定的专用单任务模型。大语言模型最近已成为跨异构任务的预测器，但其表现通常不如专用模型，且检索增强的变体会丢弃自身产生的结果。现有的基准测试也仅仅孤立地对查询进行评分，未能检验从结果中学习带来的改进。在此，我们构建了MatMemBench——一个包含22个材料任务的序列基准测试，它只在预测之后才揭示结果，并检验在线适应、记忆保持和跨任务迁移能力。我们提出了MatRecall框架，使大语言模型能够将经过验证的预测（连同证据、结果和误差）存储为情景记忆，并在无需重新训练的情况下进行回忆调用。MatRecall相比无记忆模型将中位数性能提升了62%，并超越了专用模型的表现。
tldr: 该研究提出MatRecall框架，让大语言模型将经实验验证的预测经验（含证据、结果与误差）存储为情景记忆并无需重训即可调用，使材料预测任务的中位数性能较无记忆模型提升62%并超越专用模型。
en_tdlr: This study introduces MatRecall, a framework enabling large language models to store verified prediction outcomes (with evidence, results, and errors) as episodic memories and recall them without retraining, improving median materials prediction performance by 62% over memory-free models and surpassing specialized models.
